not_covered.text: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reports that a oil tanker has caught on fire and exploded in the southern part of the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine.
A truck loses control and runs over devotees outside a temple in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India, killing at least 13 and injuring nearly 40 others.
